metadata.name: High-Resolution Weather Balloon Sounding Near North Pole (August 18, 2018)
metadata.description: A high-frequency atmospheric sounding dataset capturing a single weather balloon's vertical profile and trajectory over a 30-minute period on August 18, 2018. The data includes measurements of height, pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction, and wind speed recorded at approximately 1-second intervals near the North Pole (89.55°N, 36.84°E).
metadata.spatial: Point locations (weather balloon trajectory), ~1 Hz sampling rate
